A1.justification: Both readable 13-page PDFs describe the same KFC-W study, with matching scientific text, figures, tables and references. Neither supplied PDF contains an appendix; both refer to supplementary material outside these PDFs.

before.justification: Section 4 reports original user-study results, COLMAP reconstruction experiments and InstantSplat rendering evaluations in Tables 1–3.

after.justification: Section 4 and Tables 1–3 retain the original user-study, COLMAP and InstantSplat experimental results.

M1.justification: Section 3 retains the same joint multiview-inpainting and view-interpolation method, CLIP illumination conditioning and DDIM inference. KFC-W was already the method name in v1.

E1.justification: Both versions train on MegaScenes, RealEstate10k and DL3DV and evaluate on Phototourism and RealEstate10k. Video-generation and downstream reconstruction task coverage is unchanged.

E2.justification: Table 1 retains FLAVR, LDMVFI, FILM, Luma and Ours (Video-only). Tables 2–3 retain the same reconstruction comparisons.

E3.justification: Section 4 retains the 252 Phototourism and 600 Re10k input sets, 25-scene user study, voting procedure and rendering evaluation on 10 held-out images per scene. Training settings and evaluation metrics also match.

E4.justification: The CLIP-conditioning comparison in Figure 4, Video-only ablations and Long-Video analysis with up to five times wider training baselines in Figure 7 are unchanged.

E5.justification: User and vote counts and statistical reporting remain unchanged. Neither version reports repeated-run variability, confidence intervals or significance tests.

E6.justification: All results in Tables 1–3 and qualitative findings match. For example, COLMAP with full-model generated views succeeds on 235/252 sets in both versions; generated-frame InstantSplat PSNR remains 13.960 on Phototourism and 21.798 on Re10k.

T1.justification: Section 3 retains identical input/output definitions and frame-count expressions. Neither PDF contains formal theorems or proofs.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction and discussion retain the same claims about learning 3D-aware video generation without camera-pose supervision and supporting downstream reconstruction. Adding KFC-W to the title does not change their scope.

C2.justification: Interpretations of baseline failures and multiview inpainting's benefits are unchanged. Both retain the same qualifications concerning coarse illumination control, dynamic objects and extrapolation to unseen views.

D1.justification: Disclosed details remain identical, including training on 32 NVIDIA A100 80GB GPUs for three days and 50-step DDIM inference. The project website link and references to supplementary implementation details are unchanged.

R1.justification: The 94-item bibliography and research positioning are unchanged, including relationships to reconstruction methods, diffusion view synthesis, video models and CroCo.

P1.justification: The title gains the prefix 'KFC-W:', using an acronym already defined in v1, and the arXiv version/date stamp updates. Body wording and section organization remain unchanged.

P2.justification: All eight figure images and three table designs, captions and placements are unchanged. The title update preserves the existing page layout.

improvement.justification: v2 adds the existing method acronym to the title but retains the same scientific content, evidence, limitations and reproducibility information. This small naming edit produces no meaningful overall quality difference.
